description: Simulates cross-chain bridge and swap paths across EVM and Solana, factors gas and protocol overhead, and formats ready-to-sign execution call data.

from_address.description: User or agent sender wallet address.

from_amount.description: Source token quantity in base atomic units (e.g., '1000000' for 1 USDC).

from_token.description: Source token symbol or contract address.

slippage_tolerance.description: Maximum allowable slippage fraction (e.g., 0.005 for 0.5%). Defaults to 0.005.

to_token.description: Destination token symbol or contract address.

name: cross_chain_bridge_optimizer

economic_friction_analysis.description: Gas and protocol bridge fees breakdown
